cost_gate.COST_GATE_EV_INFLATED: rsi_buy expected_gain=(TP-entry)*units*0.43 is the probability-weighted upside only. With 0.43 being the zero-edge breakeven of the 1.5/2.0 ATR bracket, the real expectation is ~0, so 'expected_gain >= 2x cost' passes zero/negative-EV trades whenever the ATR is large relative to cost. rebalance_add (notional*ATRd%*sqrt(20)*0.25) is a volatility magnitude, not a directional edge, so it is unfounded and inflated.
cost_gate.what_2x_means: Code: PASS iff expected_gain >= 2*total_cost (equivalently net >= total_cost), where total_cost already counts the round trip (one full spread + open fee + close fee + overnight + tax on sells). It is not 2x a one-way cost. The definition is fine. It is the expected_gain input that is wrong.
cost_gate.spread: (ask-bid)*units is correct for a round trip vs mid. It falls back to an assumed 0.15% in the final stage. spread_usd overrides a wider live spread. bid==ask is accepted. No staleness check.
cost_gate.fees: A $0.75 per-order default is used when getCost gives none. In the final stage it must come from prepare/getCost (no default). FX fee: the account is in USD, so none is expected, but the field is not recorded. Negative fees and overnight are accepted.
cost_gate.tax: 25% on max(realized,0) for sell/trim only. A buy's expected gain is pre-tax (no x(1-0.25)). A rotation is not modelled as one decision (sell-leg tax + both legs' costs vs the replacement edge). trim/sell gain is caller-supplied and unverified.
cost_gate.units_rounding: Units are floored to 6dp (OK). Rounding to 4dp in the block is OK. Negative units are not rejected in evaluate().

required_corrections: 1. cost_gate rsi_buy: expected_gain = units*[p*(TP-ask) - (1-p)*(ask-SL)], then after-tax: if >0 multiply by (1-0.25). p must come from cited out-of-sample evidence, not the zero-edge value. With p=0.43 the gate must SKIP.
2. cost_gate rebalance_add: remove the ATR*sqrt(T)*0.25 'edge', or replace it with an evidenced directional edge (e.g. score/RS differential with a backtested hit-rate). Otherwise SKIP.

3. Rotation: one gate per rotation: total_cost = sell spread+close fee+tax(0.25*max(realized,0)) + buy spread+open fee+close fee; expected_gain = evidenced edge of the replacement over the held name. trim/sell expected_gain must require a method plus inputs QA can recompute.

4. Final stage fails closed: require bid, ask, quote_ts (age <= 60s) and fee sources == prepare/getCost. Reject bid>=ask with spread 0, assumed_default sources, |ask - independent live mark| > 0.1%, negative fees/overnight/units, p outside (0,1), total_cost <= 0. spread = max(spread_usd, (ask-bid)*units).

5. execute_pass verdicts: require run-QA skill=='classic-rsi-1h-run-qa' and order-QA skill=='classic-real-money-order-qa-gate', different files, each with checked_at <= 60 min old (order-QA <= 15 min), and order-QA pack_sha256 == sha256(canonical pack + final cost_gate + final_units + ask).

6. TOCTOU: make --cash mandatory and from a live portfolio read with a timestamp <= 60s. Reject a book snapshot whose asOf is > 15 min old. The agent must re-read cash right before the place, and again between sequenced places.
7. Cash floor: use the same open fee as the cost gate (if None, use DEFAULT_OPEN_FEE_USD or fail closed). cash_after = cash - units*ask - open_fee >= 2500.

8. Idempotency: write audit/placed/<sha(pack_id)>.lock before GO is returned. Refuse GO if the lock exists or an open position/order with the same instrumentId opened after the pack's bar_time exists.

9. GO must emit the exact order payload {instrumentId, isBuy:true, leverage:1, units:final_units, stopLossRate:SL, takeProfitRate:TP}, with SL>0 and SL<bid asserted. Order-QA must compare it to the prepare response. Agent placement must copy it verbatim.
10. Caps: also check name/sleeve on cost basis (positions[].invested), not only market value.
11. Add a US RTH check (NYSE session) to execute_pass. Do not let --force set auto_place_eligible.
12. Route daily rebalance actions through a code gate (execute_pass kind=trim/sell/rebalance_add/rotation), or keep the rebalance on manual authorization.

recompute.spread: max(spread_usd_from_getCost, (ask - bid) * units); quote age <= 60s; ask within 0.1% of independent live mark
recompute.fees: open_fee + close_fee, both equal to prepare/getCost (no defaults)
recompute.tax_est: 0.25 * max(realized_pnl, 0) per sell leg; summed over rotation sell legs
recompute.TP_SL: TP = ask + tp_mult*ATR1h; SL = ask - sl_mult*ATR1h; require 0 < SL < bid
recompute.expected_gain_current_code: (TP - ask) * units * p_hit   <- recompute to confirm the number, but do NOT accept it as EV
recompute.expected_gain_required: EV = units*[p*(TP-ask) - (1-p)*(ask-SL)]; EV_after_tax = EV*(1-0.25) if EV>0
recompute.pass_rule: ratio >= 2 AND expected_net_gain > 0 AND total_cost > 0 AND 0<p<1 with cited source; else COST_GATE_FAIL (risk exits exempt but numbers required)
